intro: A Glowing Ember is the lingering, elemental core recovered from a defeated Minor Manifestation of Fire atop the crags of Durotar. It serves as a vital ceremonial reagent in a shaman's trials, used to ignite the brazier at the Shrine of Eternal Flame.

p: When a rising shaman drinks the fire sapta and faces the fiery spirits atop the ridge near Telf Joolam, they confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire. Upon the elemental's defeat, this smoldering remnant is all that remains of its physical form. Still pulsing with raw elemental heat, the ember carries the living spark of fire necessary to awaken the sacred brazier at the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
